name: AzureHound - BloodHound Collection for Azure/Entra ID
description: AzureHound collects Azure AD / Entra ID and Azure Resource Manager relationships (users, groups, roles, service principals, app registrations, subscriptions, VMs) into BloodHound-ingestible JSON. It reveals attack paths in the cloud: who can reset whose password, who owns which app, which identity can escalate to Global Admin or across subscriptions.
notes:
=== AUTH + COLLECT (username/password) ===
  azurehound -u <user> -p <password> list --tenant <domain> -o output.json

=== WITH A REFRESH TOKEN / JWT ===
  azurehound -r "<refresh_token>" list --tenant <domain> -o output.json
  azurehound -j "<jwt>" list --tenant <domain> -o output.json

=== SERVICE PRINCIPAL AUTH ===
  azurehound -a <app_id> -s "<client_secret>" --tenant <domain> list -o output.json

=== COLLECT SPECIFIC DATA ===
  azurehound list users --tenant <domain>
  azurehound list groups --tenant <domain>
  azurehound list roles --tenant <domain>
  azurehound list service-principals --tenant <domain>

=== INGEST ===
  # Upload output.json into BloodHound CE (Azure data model)
  # Key queries: paths to Global Admin, app owners, SP creds abuse

=== GETTING A TOKEN (az cli) ===
  az login
  az account get-access-token --resource-type ms-graph

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  ROADrecon       # offline Azure AD dump + GUI
  Stormspotter    # ARM + AAD graph
  BloodHound CE   # consumes AzureHound output

recommended.note: ROADrecon is the offline Azure AD dump alternative.
Targeted Entra enumeration without the full graph.

defense.why_it_works: AzureHound uses legitimate Microsoft Graph and ARM read APIs available to any authenticated principal. Directory read access is broad by default, so one identity can map most tenant relationships.
defense.prerequisites: Any valid Entra identity (user, refresh token, or service principal); Graph/ARM read access.
defense.impact: Complete cloud attack-path map: privilege escalation to Global Admin, cross-subscription paths, app/SP abuse.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1087.004/T1069.003] Bulk Microsoft Graph enumeration (directoryObjects, servicePrincipals, roleAssignments) from one principal; AzureHound User-Agent; sign-in followed by high-volume Graph reads.
defense.artifacts: Entra sign-in + AuditLogs/MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs showing enumeration bursts; non-interactive token use.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=azure sourcetype=azure:graph
| stats dc(request_uri) as endpoints count by user
| where count > 500
defense.sentinel_kql:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| summarize Requests=count(), Endpoints=dcount(RequestUri) by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where Requests > 500
defense.prevention: Least-privilege directory roles; restrict directory read via admin consent policies; Conditional Access + MFA; monitor Graph activity logs for bulk enumeration; limit guest visibility.

detections.name: Bulk Entra/Graph enumeration (AzureHound)
detections.logic:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where RequestUri has_any ("/servicePrincipals","/directoryRoles","/roleManagement","/groups")
| summarize Endpoints=dcount(RequestUri), Requests=count() by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where Requests > 300
detections.false_positives: CSPM/IGA tools that enumerate the directory
